name: io.github.wishfinity/wishfinity-mcp-plusw
title: Wishfinity +W
description: Save any product URL to your Wishfinity wishlist. Works with any MCP client.

tools.name: add_to_wishlist
tools.description: Saves a product to the user's Wishfinity wishlist, so they can find it again, sort it into lists, and share it with friends and family. Use when the user wants to save, bookmark, remember or wishlist a product, or keep a gift idea for later (e.g. "save this for later", "add this to my wishlist", "save this as a gift idea for my mom"). Accepts a product page URL, or a product name when there isn't one. With a name, Wishfinity asks the user to confirm the wish before saving it. Works with any store. Wishfinity looks up the product's name, description, image and price itself when the link is opened. Returns a link the user opens to finish the save on wishfinity.com, where people without an account can sign up. Does not read or change existing lists.

url.description: The product page URL. Optional if `title` is given.

title.description: Product name, used when no product page URL is available (for example, a product the user named or showed in a photo). Up to 120 characters.
